item.title: 📆 Top News Today On a roll: Vostok Group of Forces liberated Golubkovo in Zaporozhye region.
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🚩 On a roll: Vostok Group of Forces liberated Golubkovo in Zaporozhye region. 💥 We destroyed hubs: strikes were delivered against logistics centres, transport and port infrastructure of Ukraine, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 👊 Varyags are on fire: drone operators hit enemy data processing centres , and the Northern Bridge in Kiev, as well as an aerostatic balloon . 👀 Nowhere to hide: deputy battalion CO of the 236th Guards Artillery Brigade with the call sign 'Zolotoy', described how Msta-S crews operate near the Oskol Reservoir. 📊 Defence surge: in September, more than 10,000 units of armaments, military and special equipment were supplied to the Russian Armed Forces from defence industry enterprises and 'People's Defence Industry'. Deputy Defence Minister Army General Aleksander Sanchik noted that systematic work with all state defence order contractors makes it possible to meet all the needs of the troops. Working like a well-oiled machine! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against port infrastructure of Ukraine and ships involved in the deliv
item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against port infrastructure of Ukraine and ships involved in the delivery of military cargo to Ukraine. 💥 As a result of strikes, a tanker delivering fuel and lubricants intended to support the AFU was hit in the port of Yuzhny. 💥 In addition, in a hardware parking area close to Mayaki, Russian troops hit trucks that had delivered military cargo to Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29881

❗️

item.title: 👇 Here is how our Armed Forces have been reinforced Su-57 and Su-35S fighter jets.
item.description: Here is how our Armed Forces have been reinforced 👇 ✈️ Su-57 and Su-35S fighter jets. The aircraft were delivered in a new technical configuration which helps expand their operational tasks, while the advanced capabilities built into the aviation weapons system allow for the use of new types of ordnance. 💥 T-90M, T-80BVM, and T-72B3M tanks. The accepted batches of tanks of various modifications were delivered from the factories with additional protection systems that were designed taking into account experience of the special military operation. 🎮 Troops were reinforced with Supercam, Skat, Orlan, and Molniya reconnaissance UAVs of various modifications, FPV strike drones and hexacopters, as well as multi-purpose unmanned ground vehicles. ▫️ Radar stations, Zubr air target engagement systems, ZAK-30 Citadel systems , and other ones capable of detecting, tracking, and engaging aerial targets, which have proven their effectiveness in the special military operation zone and border regions. ⚓️ As part of the Navy's re-equipment program, the latest minesweeper Semen Agafonov (Project 12700) built for the Northern Fleet was floated out in September. ⚔️ According to the Procurement Schedule, over one million units of ordnance were supplied to the troops, including a wide range of artillery ammunition, aircraft missiles and bombs, UAV warheads, anti-drone cartridges for servicemen's standard small arms, and others. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29874

Here is how our Armed Forces have been reinforced
👇
✈️
Su-57 and Su-35S fighter jets.
The aircraft were delivered in a new technical configuration which helps expand their operational tasks, while the advanced capabilities built into the aviation weapons system allow for the use of new types of ordnance.
💥
T-90M, T-80BVM, and T-72B3M tanks.
The accepted batches of tanks of various modifications were delivered from the factories with additional protection systems that were designed taking into account experience of the special military operation.
🎮
Troops were reinforced with
Supercam, Skat, Orlan, and Molniya reconnaissance UAVs
of various modifications, FPV strike drones and hexacopters, as well as multi-purpose unmanned ground vehicles.
▫️
Radar stations, Zubr air target engagement systems, ZAK-30 Citadel systems
, and other ones capable of detecting, tracking, and engaging aerial targets, which have proven their effectiveness in the special military operation zone and border regions.
⚓️
As part of the Navy's re-equipment program, the latest
minesweeper Semen Agafonov (Project 12700)
built for the Northern Fleet was floated out in September.
⚔️
According to the Procurement Schedule,
over one million units of ordnance
were supplied to the troops, including a wide range of artillery ammunition, aircraft missiles and bombs, UAV warheads, anti-drone cartridges for servicemen's standard small arms, and others.

item.description: Defenсe surge ▫️ 📊 In September, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation received over 10,000 units of weapons, military, and special equipment supplied by defenсe industry enterprises and the 'People's OPK' (People's Defense Sector) Russian Deputy Defence Minister General of the Army Aleksander Sanchik noted that military command and control bodies organise and conduct systemic work with all executors of the state defence order and enterprises of the 'People's OPK' (People's Defence Sector) to ensure uninterrupted and rhythmic supplies of highly demanded types of weapons, military, and special equipment , which makes it possible to meet the needs of the troops. In addition, an effective feedback system has been organised to carry out refinements and promptly implement the most effective solutions for the modernisation of the supplied items. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
